mechanism.claim: When completed US cash-session semiconductor and utilities ETF returns have strict opposite signs, they identify a traded growth-versus-defensive rotation impulse. During elevated BTC variation, follow the semiconductor direction for twenty-four hours after both closes are certainly public.
mechanism.side: long when SMH is positive and XLU negative; short when SMH is negative and XLU positive
mechanism.why_distinct: SMH/XLU opposite-sign disagreement isolates cyclical technology leadership versus defensive regulated-utility demand. It is not HYG/LQD credit quality, SPY/TLT liquidity consensus, broad equity direction, Treasury yield, FX, crypto flow, prior event artifact, repair, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the preceding twenty-four-hour BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, restricting the relay to July-like crypto risk states
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only opposite-sign sector-rotation sessions produce one external 23:05 UTC clock; this primitive is absent from Gross9

features.sector_source: candidate-specific Yahoo chart raw unadjusted SMH and XLU regular-session daily open/close snapshots downloaded only after preregistration push
features.session: same US trading date D with finite positive raw opens and closes for both ETFs
features.disagreement: strict opposite signs; zero in either leg is ineligible
features.availability: D 23:00 UTC, safely after the 16:00 America/New_York regular close in EST and EDT
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTCUSDT five-minute open-to-close log returns over the prior 24 elapsed hours ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 previous valid daily 23:00 UTC states, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: each shared SMH/XLU regular-session date D at 23:00 UTC
clock.side: strict SMH return sign on opposite-sign sessions
clock.reservation: chronological global half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.smh: Yahoo chart query1=2022-09-01 query2=2026-08-02 exclusive interval=1d events=history; raw open/close only
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent traded semiconductor-versus-utilities risk rotation plus requested high BTC variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no ETF substitution, adjusted-price use, disagreement relation, session, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

smh.definition: companies involved in semiconductor production and equipment

xlu.definition: utilities-sector companies including electric, water, multi-, independent-power, renewable-electricity, and gas utilities

external_basis.selection_use: official sector exposures and opposite-sign growth-versus-defensive disagreement only; no candidate incidence or economic outcomes
